provenance.provenance_correction: An earlier description called this fixture 'copied verbatim from Circle's repo' and said expected fields come from 'Circle's decoder'; both were inaccurate and corrected (audit finding). provenance.regeneration_note: Re-run from scratch when the account-id rows (di-circle-3/4) were added: the two pre-existing rows (di-circle-1/2) came back byte-for-byte identical, hashes included, which re-confirms the recipe and the earlier bytes.
provenance.identifier_shapes: di-circle-1/2 carry OPAQUE bytes32 identifiers and di-circle-3/4 carry Miden account ids in the right-aligned packaging (16 zero bytes, then prefix and suffix as big-endian u64s; the same two ids as aid-rt-2 / aid-rt-1 of the Miden golden-vector artifact). envelope_verdict: CONFIRMED (all fields match Miden DC-1 layout; zero divergences)
